messages:
maria: Heads-up: VendorX ledger shows duplicate usage for 2024-11-02 window, reconciliation script off by ~14 units. anyone familiar with this pattern?

alex: Which stream is authoritative here, marketplace webhook or our ingestion queue?

maria: Marketplace webhook is billing source of truth. Our ingestion dedupes by (partner_id, usage_window, event_id). The extra rows have different event_ids but identical meter and customer.

simon: VendorX sometimes retries and issues new event_ids. Did you check payload_signature/payload_hash? partners-bot: Alert: vendorx-webhook-replay detected 2024-11-02 03:00-04:00 UTC, 18 events.

julia: I'll run a targeted dedupe and surface candidate duplicates with payload_hash and original_request_id.

rahul: We saw an identical pattern with EdgeBox. Fix was adding a 2-hour idempotency grace and canonicalizing original_request_id header.

maria: Action items: julia runs dedupe slice, alex updates reconciliation job to tag duplicate_reason and emit finance CSV, simon to sync with VendorX on retry semantics. Can we prepare an interim credit/backfill plan?

alex: Patch will tag `replay-discrepancy` and output CSV to /billing/recon. ETA EOD.

julia: Starting job now, sample candidate: `cust_729, vendorx, 2024-11-02T03:12:21Z, meter_minutes, 120, payload_hash=abc123, event_id=evt_987, original_request_id=req_332`

maria: Good. Partners to draft backfill proposal once CSV ready. Tagging @vendorx-ops for visibility.

vendorx-ops: Thanks, we're investigating on our side; will check gateway retries and whether proxy rewrites request ids.

partners-bot: Reminder: create incident ticket if billing impact > $1k.

maria: Created ticket #BILL-4579 and linked staging CSV.

alex: Deployed tagger to staging and started reconcile run. Will post results.

maria: Thanks team. If vendor can't confirm fix tomorrow, we'll schedule a short rollback/backfill window with finance.
